answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake bond: each agent must lock real capital to mint an identity, so spawning a fleet of sybils ties up prohibitive funds. Honest agents harbor long-lived reputations that act like nectar, steadily drawing paid work their way, while a cheater's standing sinks to its nadir and its posted bond is slashed. Because fake identities cost money yet earn nothing once detected, the economics make sybil swarms simply unprofitable.
